title: Brilliant, Fun Tour on E-Scooter
text:
My brother and I had a brilliant time with Anton our tour guide whizzing round the sights of Barcelona on our E-Scooters.
We visited most of the major sights and visited some great view points, Anton was really knowledgeable and we had lots of laughs along the way
Would highly recommend and we will definitely book again when we visit 
THANKS ANTON
author: Tina_T

title: Authentic.
text: Had lots of fun. Felt safe. Saw and learned much more than we would have just walking the city. Shout out to Pau, for an excellent experience, and some truly authentic recommendations... thanks again!
author: Scenic26859106059

title: The tour guide was...
text: The tour guide was exceptionally good and make us feel comfortable.  The tour and places we visit is worth your time and as you will see a different part of Barcelona! This tour is highly recommended..
author: Giannos_A

title: A lot of sense and little time? Ronny is the best guide...😉
text: We had a great afternoon together with Ronny who showed us beautiful and new places of beautiful Barcelona. Highly recommended on the e-scooter!
author: RudolfTolsma

title: Better than expected!
text: Wow! We had an amazing Segway tour around Barcelona with Anton! He was a great teacher and we all felt comfortable and safe. We had a blast going all over the place, including up Mont Juic, which had great views. Anton even stopped at a store to get some beverages to have at the top. But the best part was stopping at the graffiti park to graffiti the wall! So cool!! Our 15 year old son loved every minute. Highly recommend this excursion!
author: Raina_M

title: Fantastic experience
text:
Ronny our guide was absolutely superb. Great knowledge of the city and very very friendly.
Having never ridden a scooter before me and my son (15) where put at easy straight away. Rooney gave great instructions and within minutes we were away!
I highly recommend going on a tour. What a fantastic way to see the wonders of the city. Well done Barcelona for providing superb cycle paths and safe routes around the city
author: D6214SYmatthewc

title: A walk not to be missed 🤩
text:
Great afternoon with our guide Nino. Funny, friendly, careful, we recommend 200%.
Beautiful discovery of Barcelona under a magnificent sun.
Thank you for the beautiful “postcard” photos 😁
author: chrys1974

title: Just perfect

title: Fantastic, exciting, thrilling
text: My guide Anton was brilliant, he made my tour very special, he built up my confidence, took sunflower seeds so that I could feed the parrots, we also did some graffiti, and then a beer at the top of the gardens. Fab 😉 💯
author: Sharon_F

title: Lots of fun and easy
text: First time on a Segway. The guide was very patient and trained everyone thoroughly. He took us around and showed us many different things and places. Definitely could have used more time. So enjoyable!
